title: A Multimodal Emotion Recognition System: Integrating Facial Expressions, Body Movement, Speech, and Spoken Language
abstract: arXiv:2412.17907v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Psychological evaluation relies on clinicians' observation and interpretation of a patient's emotional expression, which is susceptible to subjectivity, bias, fatigue, and inconsistency. This paper presents a multimodal emotion recognition system designed to support, rather than replace, the evaluator. The system combines facial expression recognition, speech emotion recognition, text-based emotion recognition of transcribed speech, and body movement analysis, and fuses their outputs into an emotional profile of class probabilities that is presented to the evaluator together with the overall prediction. Although the unimodal models achieve high accuracy on their benchmark test sets, a remote user study with 52 participants expressing seven emotional states shows that their accuracy falls to between 82.97% and 87.64% under realistic conditions, with individual emotional states recognised in as few as 48.08% of cases. translated_title: 一种多模态情感识别系统：整合面部表情、身体动作、语音与口语语言
translated_abstract: 心理学评估依赖于临床医生对患者情绪表达的观察和解读，这一过程容易受到主观性、偏见、疲劳和不一致性的影响。本文提出了一种多模态情感识别系统，旨在辅助而非取代评估者。该系统结合了面部表情识别、语音情感识别、基于转录文本的情感识别以及身体动作分析，并将它们的输出融合为包含类别概率的情绪特征，连同整体预测一起呈现给评估者。尽管单模态模型在其基准测试集上取得了较高的准确率，但一项有52名参与者表达七种情绪状态的远程用户研究表明，在现实条件下其准确率下降至82.97%至87.64%之间，某些个体情绪状态的识别率甚至低至48.08%。
tldr: 本文提出了一种整合面部表情、身体动作、语音和口语的多模态情感识别系统，旨在辅助而非取代心理评估者，并通过真实条件下的用户研究揭示了模型准确率从基准测试到现实场景的显著下降。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a multimodal emotion recognition system integrating facial expressions, body movement, speech, and spoken language to support rather than replace psychological evaluators, revealing through a real-world user study the significant accuracy drop from benchmark performance to realistic conditions.
